_readme: WHAT EACH FIXTURE IS, and what may be said about it in public.
This lives OUTSIDE the evidence documents on purpose. `acquisition`
answers how real evidence reached an Assessment -- `collected` or
`imported` -- and adding `synthetic` to it would let a production
Assessment validate constructed evidence. They are two questions: one is
about the evidence, the other is about what that file is for in this
It exists because the product page presented `list-over-limit.json` with
`Collected` and a date, and it read as a reading taken from a tenant. It
is a construction. The result the Engine produces from it is true; the
No synthetic fixture may carry it as `true`.

the shape of a real assignment acquisition: SKUs and assigned units read, the report identifiability setting observed as concealed, usage and dependency not observed. The directory it came from is not identified and the counts are not that tenant's
assignment read with no usage report; constructed so unread is not read as unused

one SKU of every class the read can settle and one it cannot: a Company target, a subscription in warning, a cancelled one, an undocumented target class, and a row carrying a million units so no threshold can be introduced without failing a test

the commercial subscriptions read and joined: a bought subscription, one on a free evaluation, a Company SKU, two free self-service programmes that report isTrial false, and one SKU whose subscription was not returned
the commercial subscription surface answering that it does not exist in this cloud, which is not the same answer as a run that did not ask

a real collector run on a machine without the Microsoft Graph modules; the host is replaced because the document establishes nothing about any tenant and the name would be a customer identifier for no evidential gain
usage read and unattributable; constructed to exercise the default tenant, where no per-user licensing conclusion is possible
usage attributable; constructed to exercise the tenant that turned concealment off
the same report in a tenant that conceals identifiable information; constructed so that rows returned and rows attributable are read as two different numbers
a usage report read in a tenant that allows attribution; constructed to exercise rows that name a principal
the same estate afterwards, with one library unreadable; constructed so a verification can be produced and checked without a tenant
the estate as it stood before a move; constructed so a verification can be produced and checked without a tenant
